META_DESCRIPTION: Track premiums, copays, prescriptions, and dental. FincWin's Healthcare envelope keeps your medical costs from surprising you.
HERO_H1:
Healthcare costs are
the ones that blindside you most.
HERO_SUB: Premiums, copays, prescriptions, dental, vision — healthcare spending is unpredictable by nature. FincWin's Healthcare envelope helps you plan for the unexpected before it arrives.
PAIN_H2:
Medical costs hit hardest
when you're least prepared.
PAIN_ITEM_1_H3: The deductible you forgot you had
PAIN_ITEM_1_P: January rolls around and your deductible resets. That prescription that cost $15 in December is $65 in January. You knew it was coming and still didn't plan for it.
PAIN_ITEM_2_P: A single crown: $1,200. Insurance covers 50%. You owe $600 in one go. Without a healthcare buffer in your budget, that comes straight from next month's rent money.
PAIN_ITEM_3_P: $25 copay here, $40 prescription there, $95 for that specialist visit your plan barely covered. Three months of "small" healthcare costs can easily total $400+.
FEATURES_H2:
The Healthcare envelope:
plan for the unpredictable.
CARD_1_P: Set a Healthcare cap that includes a buffer for unexpected costs. FincWin shows you how much of your healthcare budget is committed vs available for surprises.
CARD_2_P: Log each prescription with frequency — monthly, quarterly, or annual. See your total committed prescription spend at a glance every time you open the app.
CARD_3_P: Log your deductible reset as a January calendar event. FincWin reminds you when higher out-of-pocket costs are coming so you can adjust your cap proactively.
